description: This file defines interfaces and data structures for Orleans grains used in unit tests, including an enum, a serializable struct, and a grain interface with asynchronous methods.

classes.name: ReturnCode
classes.description: Enumeration representing success or failure status codes.

classes.name: MemberVariables
classes.description: Serializable struct holding a byte array, a string, and a ReturnCode, used as a data transfer object.

classes.name: IGeneratorTestGrain
classes.description: Interface for a test grain with methods to set and get member variables asynchronously.

methods.name: StringIsNullOrEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the string is null or empty asynchronously.
